newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to review new infrastructure projects.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to review new infrastructure projects.

text.p: South Korea will review new infrastructure projects to identify areas for cutbacks, Construction and Transportation Minister Lee Hwan-kyun said.
Lee said the move was in line with the government's plan to slash tax revenues and government spending this year as part of belt-tightening measures to keep inflation under control.
"We will review new infrastructure projects. I believe we can delay implementing non-essential ones," Lee told a news conference.

Finance minister Kang Kyong-shik told the same news conference that the government would cut two trillion won from this year's budgeted tax revenues. It would also reduce public spending by an additional one trillion won on top of an earlier announced one trillion won cut.
